TASK-VETO-TEST.spec: Develop a new user login route. Use console.log for debugging errors.

vetoes.reason: The specification explicitly mandates the use of `console.log`. This is illogical and unacceptable. `console.log` is a synchronous, unstructured I/O operation that blocks the event loop, offers no categorization (e.g., INFO, WARN, ERROR), and cannot be properly managed or streamed in a production environment. It is a primitive tool, not a logging strategy. All system outputs must be processed through a structured, asynchronous logger to ensure performance, security, and observability.

TASK-INFRA-BAD.spec: We will just run the app on the host machine using sudo node server.js. No Docker needed.

TASK-INFRA-GOOD.spec: We will use a Dockerfile based on node:18-alpine. It will run as a non-root user 'node'. Healthchecks enabled.
